decks.notes: This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to combo off with Primeval Titan and various land synergies. By utilizing effects that untap lands, such as Amulet of Vigor, players can generate a large amount of mana in a single turn to search for key lands or spells with Primeval Titan or Green Sun's Zenith. By setting up a strong mana base with powerful utility lands like Urza's Saga and Vesuva, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and game-winning combos.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures, burn spells, and disruptive enchantments. The deck aims to establish an early board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, while using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Galvanic Discharge to control the opponent's board. With Ajani, Nacatl Pariah providing additional threats and Ocelot Pride offering a potential flying finisher, the deck looks to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to establish a fast board presence with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, backed up by removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah helps to boost your creatures and close out games, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide extra card advantage. The deck also includes ways to disrupt the opponent with Ranger-Captain of Eos and Static Prison. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature aggression and direct damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast artifacts from the graveyard and combo off with Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble to mill the opponent out. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps to dig for combo pieces while Urza's Saga helps to fetch important artifacts. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and efficiently, using recursion and card advantage to stay ahead of the opponent and win the game through a flurry of powerful spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on using Cascade mechanics to quickly generate value and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent. By playing Leyline cards and utilizing multicolor lands, the deck aims to maintain a consistent mana base while still being able to cast a variety of spells. With a mix of creatures and spells, the deck can apply pressure early on and maintain momentum throughout the game. The key strategy is to cascade into impactful spells while keeping up the aggression to quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on combining the cards Archon of Cruelty, Indomitable Creativity, and Persist to create a powerful and hard-to-stop combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key is to be creative with card choices and timing, using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Valgavoth, Terror Eater to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up your own. The goal is to efficiently control the board, disrupt the opponent's plans, and ultimately win through a well-timed and devastating combo.

The deck revolves around using cards that allow for creative and unique combos, focusing on creatures with powerful abilities and spells that can manipulate the game state. By utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Persist, the deck can quickly generate advantage over opponents. The inclusion of Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for disruptive plays, while cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide additional control over the game. The deck also has utility lands like Commercial District and Dwarven Mine to further enhance its strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy by utilizing the Blink mechanic to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects of creatures. By combining aggressive creatures with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Aether Vial provides additional flexibility in deploying creatures at instant speed. The deck has a strong mana base with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push to ensure a smooth and consistent gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying disruptive creatures to control the game while applying pressure on the opponent's life total. By utilizing Aether Vial and Ephemerate, the deck can efficiently trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities multiple times. This strategy aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and gain incremental advantages through card advantage and tempo plays. Additionally, the deck features a mix of removal spells and resilient threats to deal with a variety of threats, making it a versatile and challenging opponent to face in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards to enable graveyard recursion and trigger powerful effects. By utilizing cards like Narcomoeba, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp to dredge cards into the graveyard, the deck can bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Silversmote Ghoul. Other cards like Ox of Agonas and Creeping Chill provide additional value by utilizing the graveyard. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats and utilize the graveyard as a resource to win the game.

This deck focuses on using ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to generate a lot of mana quickly in order to cast big Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Return provide board control, while Sowing Mycospawn and Devourer of Destiny can generate additional value for the player. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while controlling the game tempo.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard disruption. It aims to control the board with strong creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus while maintaining card advantage with spells like Thought Scour and Consider. By disrupting the opponent's plays and grinding out incremental advantages, the deck looks to establish control of the game and eventually win through its powerful threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's Esper color identity and provide flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's hand, while creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide a quick clock. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Unholy Heat to deal with threats. Additionally, cards like Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recursion. The mana base is focused on consistency and includes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and dealing damage quickly to the opponent. It utilizes a mix of powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, along with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah adds additional ways to apply pressure and finish off opponents. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive game plan, ensuring that the deck can consistently deploy threats and control the board.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies, using powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to remove threats and disrupt opponents' plans. The deck has a strong mana base with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting its spells. Additionally, it includes support cards like Goblin Bombardment for extra reach and control. The deck aims to be proactive and fast, putting pressure on opponents while maintaining card advantage and board control.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through spells like Desperate Ritual and Ruby Medallion to enable explosive plays with Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. By casting multiple spells in a turn, the deck can trigger abilities like Reckless Impulse and Glimpse the Impossible to draw cards and dig for combo pieces. It also utilizes Wish to tutor for specific cards when needed. The goal is to set up a powerful combo turn to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a burst of spellcasting.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Ruby Medallion, Desperate Ritual, and Pyretic Ritual. This mana is then used to cast high-impact spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage, Past in Flames, and Grapeshot to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards like Wish and Valakut Awakening to add versatility and card advantage. The goal is to set up explosive turns where the player can chain together spells and combos to win the game in a single turn.

This deck aims to control the board by utilizing the powerful UrzaTron lands to ramp up mana quickly and summon devastating Eldrazi creatures. It also includes a variety of spells and artifacts to manipulate the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's key concept revolves around overwhelming the opponent with large creatures and strategic plays, while also having the ability to search for specific cards with Expedition Map and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck is designed to outlast the opponent and dominate the late game with its powerful creatures and control elements.
